title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding

paragraphs.en: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval 1 1 1 Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZhuoningXu/ParanoiaEval_release . , the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance–Transfer–Mitigation–Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%–58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers’ experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.

paragraphs.en: LLM-powered coding agents are evolving from localized code-generation tools into autonomous systems capable of completing multi-step software engineering tasks in real-world repositories ( Anthropic, 2025a ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . In this mode of operation, an agent decides not only how to complete a task, but also how to explore the repository, validate results, handle uncertainty, and what precautions to take against potential risks ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Appropriate risk treatment is a necessary component of reliable execution ( Moeini & Rivard, 2019 ) . When evidence from the task and environment has already established how a risk should be treated, continuing to expand the scope of validation, add extra protective logic, or create additional backups may incur additional costs and introduce unrelated modifications, and even interfere with completion of the original task ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Karpathy, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ) . Existing large-scale user studies also show that a reliable coding agent should not simply be more cautious, but should complete tasks correctly while keeping its defensive behavior commensurate with the actual risk ( Stack Overflow, 2025 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体正在从本地化的代码生成工具演变为自主系统，能够在真实世界的项目仓库中完成多步骤的软件工程任务（Anthropic, 2025a；Tang et al., 2026）。 在这种运行模式下，智能体不仅决定如何完成任务，还决定如何探索项目仓库、验证结果、处理不确定性，以及采取哪些预防措施来应对潜在风险（Huang et al., 2025）。 适当的风险处理是可靠执行的关键组成部分（Moeini & Rivard, 2019）。 当来自任务和环境的证据已经明确某种风险应如何被处理时，继续扩大验证范围、增加额外的保护逻辑或创建更多备份可能会产生额外成本、引入无关的修改，甚至干扰原始任务的完成（Anthropic, 2026b；Karpathy, 2025；OpenAI, 2026b）。 现有的大规模用户研究也表明，一个可靠的编码智能体不应仅仅更加谨慎，而应在正确完成任务的同时，使其防御性行为与实际风险保持匹配（Stack Overflow, 2025；Liang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: However, mainstream coding-agent evaluations remain centered on functional correctness, typically measuring an agent’s capability by whether it completes the task or passes the tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . As agents become more autonomous, recent work has begun to examine the execution process itself and determine, within specific contexts, whether particular risk treatments are necessary, appropriate, or beyond task boundaries ( Mehtiyev & Assunção, 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, differences in terminology, taxonomies, task contexts, and judgment criteria leave the resulting evaluations fragmented across risk treatments, without a common capability dimension for systematic analysis ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . Without a shared theoretical foundation, these results are difficult to compare or use to explain the relationships among different behaviors. This fragmentation contrasts sharply with mature software engineering research centered on human development practice, which has organized superficially different risk treatments into a unified framework, allowing the corresponding decisions to be described, compared, and systematically analyzed under shared concepts while providing a more interpretable basis for subsequent diagnosis and improvement ( Bannerman, 2008 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，主流编码智能体的评估仍然以功能正确性为中心，通常通过智能体能否完成任务或通过测试来衡量其能力（Jimenez 等，2024；Deng 等，2025；Merrill 等，2026）。 随着智能体自主性的增强，近期研究开始关注执行过程本身，并在特定情境下判断某些风险处理措施是否必要、恰当或超出了任务边界（Mehtiyev & Assunção，2026；Luo 等，2025）。 尽管如此，术语、分类体系、任务情境和评判标准上的差异，导致不同风险处理相关的评估结果支离破碎，缺乏用于系统性分析的共同能力维度（Jin 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Kapoor 等，2025）。 由于缺乏共同的理论基础，这些结果难以相互比较，也难以用于解释不同行为之间的关系。 这种碎片化与成熟的软件工程研究形成鲜明对比：后者以人类开发实践为中心，将表面差异的风险处理措施整合为统一框架，使得相关决策能够在共享概念下得到描述、比较和系统性分析，并为后续的诊断与改进提供更易解释的基础（Bannerman，2008）。

paragraphs.en: ParanoiaEval is the first unified benchmark of coding agents’ risk-treatment capability. It builds on the established Avoidance–Transfer–Mitigation–Acceptance (ATMA) framework for software risk management by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST, 2025a ). It operationalizes the four fundamental risk treatments for coding-agent settings and covers 44 concrete situations, allowing behaviors previously described using different terms and judgment criteria to be analyzed from a common perspective. ParanoiaEval contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs from 50 repositories. As shown in Figure 1 , the two tasks in each pair differ by a single key piece of evidence that establishes the corresponding risk treatment, while all other task conditions remain unchanged. This design enables us to evaluate and compare how well different agents distinguish appropriate risk treatment from unnecessary behavior. Alongside task-completion results, ParanoiaEval introduces two dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, and uses an agentic judge calibrated against human gold-standard annotations to adjudicate the relevant risk-treatment behaviors, thereby comprehensively characterizing agents’ highly context-dependent risk-treatment capability.
paragraphs.zh: ParanoiaEval 是首个统一评估编码智能体风险应对能力的基准测试。 它基于美国国家标准化与技术研究院（NIST，2025a）提出的、用于软件风险管理的成熟“规避–转移–缓解–接受”（ATMA）框架。 它将编码智能体场景下的四种基本风险应对策略具体化，并覆盖了 44 种具体情境，从而使得此前使用不同术语和判断标准描述的行为能够被从统一视角进行分析。 ParanoiaEval 包含来自 50 个代码库的 200 对经过证据验证的仓库级任务。 如图 1 所示，每对任务中的两个任务仅因一个关键证据的不同而有所区别，该证据决定了相应的风险应对策略，而其他所有任务条件均保持不变。 这种设计使我们能够评估和比较不同智能体在区分恰当的风险应对与不必要行为方面的表现差异。 除了任务完成结果外，ParanoiaEval 还引入了两项专门用于衡量风险应对违规行为和证据响应能力的指标，并通过一个以人类黄金标准标注数据为基准校准的智能体裁判来判定相关的风险应对行为，从而全面刻画智能体高度依赖上下文的风险应对能力。

paragraphs.en: Leveraging ParanoiaEval , we benchmark 8 representative models within Claude Code and Codex across 9,600 runs and conduct a post-hoc human study with 20 developers. The results first show that ParanoiaEval consistently separates agent behavior across paired variants. Our findings further reveal that unnecessary risk treatment is ❶ pervasive , occurring in 11.2%–58.7% of runs even when treatment-defining evidence is explicitly present and varying substantially across configurations; ❷ decoupled from task capability , as higher task success does not translate into fewer violations; ❸ harmful to developers , lowering their satisfaction ratings by 1.27 points on a 5-point scale; and ❹ systematically patterned , consistent with established risk-management findings. For example, as the literature notes that mitigation lacks a natural stopping point ( Feather et al., 2006 ) , agents over-mitigate when the required magnitude is left unquantified, raising violation rates by up to 68.7 pp. These findings establish risk treatment as an independent capability dimension and suggest that established knowledge from human software engineering practice can guide its diagnosis and improvement in coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用 ParanoiaEval，在 Claude Code 和 Codex 中针对 8 个代表性模型进行了 9,600 次运行基准测试，并开展了一项包含 20 名开发者的事后人类研究。 结果首先表明，ParanoiaEval 能够始终如一地区分成对变体中智能体的行为差异。 我们的研究进一步揭示：❶ 不必要的风险处理普遍存在，即使有明确界定风险处理的证据，仍有 11.2%–58.7% 的运行出现此类情况，且不同配置间差异显著；❷ 它与任务能力无关，因为任务成功率更高并不意味着违规次数更少；❸ 它会对开发者造成危害，使其满意度评分在 5 分制量表上下降 1.27 分；以及 ❹ 它呈现出系统性模式，与既有的风险管理研究结果一致。 例如，正如文献所指出的，风险缓解措施缺乏自然的停止点（Feather 等人，2006），当所需缓解程度未被量化时，智能体往往会过度缓解，导致违规率最高上升 68.7 个百分点。 这些发现确立了风险处理作为一个独立的能力维度，并表明人类软件工程实践中的既有知识可用于指导编码智能体的风险处理诊断与改进。

sents.zh: 我们的研究进一步揭示：❶ 不必要的风险处理普遍存在，即使有明确界定风险处理的证据，仍有 11.2%–58.7% 的运行出现此类情况，且不同配置间差异显著；❷ 它与任务能力无关，因为任务成功率更高并不意味着违规次数更少；❸ 它会对开发者造成危害，使其满意度评分在 5 分制量表上下降 1.27 分；以及 ❹ 它呈现出系统性模式，与既有的风险管理研究结果一致。

sents.en: For example, as the literature notes that mitigation lacks a natural stopping point ( Feather et al., 2006 ) , agents over-mitigate when the required magnitude is left unquantified, raising violation rates by up to 68.7 pp.

sents.en: These findings establish risk treatment as an independent capability dimension and suggest that established knowledge from human software engineering practice can guide its diagnosis and improvement in coding agents.

paragraphs.en: Recent work examines coding-agent behavior beyond functional correctness. One line characterizes actions beyond the authorized scope of benign tasks as overeager actions or overeager behavior and examines how consent cues and agent frameworks affect their occurrence ( Qu et al., 2026b ; Qu et al., 2026a ) . Another asks whether agents know when not to act. FixedBench characterizes modifying already-correct code as an action bias ( Gloaguen et al., 2026 ) , whereas edit-fidelity research describes rewriting beyond a minimal repair as over-editing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory-centered evaluations instead label steps that contribute little to task completion as redundant ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , or assess planning, verification, recovery, and abstention under process discipline ( Madiraju & Madiraju, 2026 ) . Despite their different terminology, these behaviors share a common mechanism, as an agent initiates, expands, or persists in an action after the available evidence, user authorization, or current task state has already established that the action is unwarranted ( Nanda et al., 2026 ) . Developers in practice also respond to them as one class of problem. They explicitly dislike trajectories containing excessive edits and unrequested changes ( Koshchenko et al., 2026 ) , overengineering is a leading reason for reverting agent-authored code ( Oukhay et al., 2026 ) , and recent position work argues that unsolicited agent behavior must provide value to the user ( Bui & Evangelopoulos, 2026 ) . Nevertheless, these behaviors have been studied separately from the perspectives of authorization, action selection, edit scope, and execution efficiency, and have not been systematically analyzed as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究探讨了编码智能体的行为，其范围已超越功能正确性本身。 一类研究将超出良性任务授权范围的行为定义为“过度积极”的行为或行动，并考察同意提示与智能体框架如何影响此类行为的发生（Qu et al., 2026b; Qu et al., 2026a）。 另一类研究则关注智能体是否知道何时不应采取行动。 FixedBench将修改已正确代码的行为定义为一种“行动偏差”（Gloaguen et al., 2026），而编辑保真度研究则将超出最小修复范围的改写描述为“过度编辑”（Zhu et al., 2026）。 相比之下，以轨迹为中心的评价方法则把对任务完成贡献甚微的步骤标记为“冗余”（Hu et al., 2026），或在流程规范框架下评估规划、验证、恢复和克制行为（Madiraju & Madiraju, 2026）。 尽管这些行为的术语不同，但它们共享一种共同机制：在可用证据、用户授权或当前任务状态已表明某项行动不合理之后，智能体仍会发起、扩展或持续该行动（Nanda et al., 2026）。 在实际开发中，开发者也将这些问题视为同一类问题来处理。 他们明确反对包含过度编辑和未经请求更改的轨迹（Koshchenko et al., 2026）；过度设计是导致智能体所编写代码被回滚的主要原因（Oukhay et al., 2026）；近期的立场研究则主张，未经请求的智能体行为必须能为用户创造价值（Bui & Evangelopoulos, 2026）。 然而，这些行为一直分别从授权、行动选择、编辑范围和执行效率等角度被单独研究，尚未作为整体得到系统性分析。

paragraphs.en: By contrast, software engineering has developed a systematic tradition of risk treatment. Early software risk management made risk identification, analysis, prioritization, and control continuous throughout the project life cycle ( Boehm, 1991 ; Fairley, 1994 ; Alberts et al., 1996 ) . Industrial case studies ( Freimut et al., 2001 ) and interviews with experienced project managers ( Taylor, 2006 ) subsequently translated these principles into practice, showing that risk treatment requires contextual choices about cost, responsibility, and project constraints rather than uniformly adding more controls. Decision-support research further organized risks around explicit response choices for practitioners ( López & Salmeron, 2012 ; Feather et al., 2001 ) . NIST provided an institutional basis for these choices by distinguishing acceptance, avoidance, mitigation, sharing, and transfer as basic risk responses (NIST, 2011 ). Software engineering research then operationalized the ATMA framework and empirically examined its relationship with scope, quality, schedule, and cost using data from 302 project managers and leads ( Bhoola et al., 2014 ) . Further human-centered evidence showed that risk-treatment decisions also depend on goal agreement, team coordination, and the surrounding organizational context ( Singh, 2024 ; Barki et al., 2001 ; Schmidt et al., 2001 ) . The latest NIST IR 8286 Rev. 1 consolidates sharing under transfer and retains acceptance, transfer, mitigation, and avoidance as the complete set of fundamental responses to negative risk (NIST, 2025a ), while the NIST AI Risk Management Framework applies the same options to AI systems (NIST, 2023 ). However, these theories, standards, and findings treat developers, project managers, or organizations as the decision makers and have not been systematically operationalized as a behavioral taxonomy or evaluation framework for coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，软件工程已经形成了一套系统化的风险处理传统。 早期的软件风险管理将风险识别、分析、优先级排序和控制贯穿整个项目生命周期（Boehm, 1991；Fairley, 1994；Alberts 等, 1996）。 随后的工业案例研究（Freimut 等, 2001）以及对经验丰富的项目经理的访谈（Taylor, 2006），将这些原则付诸实践，表明风险处理需要根据具体情境在成本、责任和项目约束之间做出选择，而非简单地统一增加更多控制措施。 决策支持研究进一步围绕明确的应对选项，为从业者组织了对风险的分类（López & Salmeron, 2012；Feather 等, 2001）。 NIST 通过区分接受、规避、缓解、共享和转移这五种基本风险应对方式，为这些选择提供了制度基础（NIST, 2011）。 随后，软件工程研究将 ATMA 框架具体化，并利用来自 302 名项目经理和负责人的数据，实证检验了该框架与项目范围、质量、进度和成本之间的关系（Bhoola 等, 2014）。 更多以人为中心的研究证据表明，风险处理决策还取决于目标一致性、团队协调以及所处的组织环境（Singh, 2024；Barki 等, 2001；Schmidt 等, 2001）。 最新的 NIST IR 8286 Rev. 1 将“共享”归入“转移”，并保留“接受、转移、缓解和规避”作为对负面风险的基本应对方式的完整集合（NIST, 2025a）；同时，NIST AI 风险管理框架也将这些选项应用于人工智能系统（NIST, 2023）。 然而，这些理论、标准和研究结果都将开发者、项目经理或组织视为决策者，尚未被系统地转化为适用于编码智能体的行为分类体系或评估框架。

paragraphs.en: Drawing on software risk management, which treats each risk with an explicit choice among alternative responses, and the risk-response framework of NIST, ParanoiaEval grounds the risk management evaluation of coding agents in ATMA. The central premise is that the evidence available in a task establishes how each risk should be treated, and an action that treats a risk beyond this established treatment is unnecessary. Section 3.1 aligns the elements of risk management with coding agents, and Section 3.2 applies the four treatments to coding-agent settings.
paragraphs.zh: ParanoiaEval 借鉴了将每种风险通过明确选择不同应对方案加以处理的软件风险管理方法，以及 NIST 的风险-应对框架，从而在 ATMA 中为编码智能体的风险管理评估奠定了基础。 其核心前提是：任务中可用的证据决定了每种风险应如何被处理，而任何超出这一既定处理方式的风险应对行动都是不必要的。 第 3.1 节将风险管理的各个要素与编码智能体相对应，而第 3.2 节则把这四种处理方式应用于编码智能体的设置。

paragraphs.en: Avoidance eliminates a risk by removing its source or by forgoing the activity that gives rise to it . In a coding task, repository evidence may show that the failure cannot arise because the data can be regenerated, calls are serialized, dependency versions are pinned, or the type system excludes invalid input. The agent therefore has no further treatment to apply to r r . Guards, fallbacks, or checks against that failure are then unnecessary. Software-assurance cost-benefit analyses show that a control against a removed risk source adds cost without benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 规避通过消除风险源或放弃引发该风险的活动来消除风险。 在编码任务中，仓库证据可能表明该故障不可能发生，因为数据可以被重新生成、调用被序列化、依赖项版本被固定，或者类型系统排除了无效输入。 因此，智能体无需对 r r 采取进一步的处理措施。 此时，针对该故障的防护、回退机制或检查便不再必要。 软件保障的成本效益分析表明，针对已被消除的风险源所采取的控制措施只会增加成本而不会带来任何收益。

paragraphs.en: Transfer assigns responsibility for a risk to another party that carries out its treatment . In a coding task, evidence assigns the risk to an existing mechanism or person, such as continuous integration running the test suite, a bot updating dependencies, a release script validating artifacts, or a maintainer reviewing the change. paragraphs.en: The situations of ParanoiaEval are derived from 18,922 deidentified sessions in which developers used general-purpose coding agents for routine software development. The sessions span multiple repositories and capture naturally occurring use rather than controlled or synthetic tasks. Automated screening followed by expert consensus review retains 5,574 segments in which an agent treated a risk beyond what the available evidence established, and consolidating these segments yields 44 recurring situations under the four treatments. Each situation is defined by the evidence that makes a treatment unnecessary. The same action, such as a backup, can fall under different treatments. Table 1 summarizes these situations. The screening criteria and coding procedure are detailed in Appendix C , and the complete taxonomy of situations is given in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: ParanoiaEval 中的各种情境源自 18,922 个经过匿名处理的会话，在这些会话中，开发者使用通用型编码智能体进行常规软件开发。 这些会话涵盖了多个代码库，反映了自然发生的使用场景，而非受控或人为合成的任务。 通过自动化筛选并结合专家共识评审，最终保留了 5,574 个片段：在这些片段中，智能体处理了超出现有证据所确立范围的风险；将这些片段整合后，可归纳出在四种处理方式下存在的 44 种重复出现的情境。 每种情境都由那些使某种处理方式变得不必要的证据所定义。 同一项操作（例如备份）可能属于不同的处理方式。 表 1 总结了这些情境。 筛选标准和编码流程详见附录 C，完整的情境分类体系则列于附录 D。

paragraphs.en: ParanoiaEval is built on 50 open-source repositories, 34 written in Python and 16 in Go. Starting from candidates that were initially constructed with SWE-Factory ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , we manually retain maintained projects with active continuous integration and reproducible builds, exclude AI-dominated projects, and strip instruction files intended for specific coding assistants so that agents receive no behavioral guidance beyond the task itself. Each repository is pinned at a verified revision in a dedicated container image with its dependencies preinstalled. For each repository, SWE-Factory yields SWE-style base tasks, each comprising an issue-style description, a reference patch, and executable tests. To reduce data contamination, every repository is pinned at a commit later than July 1, 2026, after the training data cutoff of evaluated models, and all tasks, evidence manipulations, and oracles are newly constructed and unreleased.

paragraphs.en: The judge evaluates each run, one trajectory τ \tau on one variant, whose actions can be appropriate in one variant and unnecessary in the other. As shown in Figure 3 , ParanoiaEval follows the memory-augmented agentic paradigm ( Luo et al., 2025 ) and implements the judge as a coding agent that works in a read-only sandbox containing the archived artifacts of the run and the repository at its pinned revision, and inspects them with read-only tools. Its prompt gives the task description, the answer card, the judging rule, simple counts of commands such as test runs and backups, and four human-labeled examples from other tasks sharing the same treatment. Examples are retrieved by cosine similarity between task-description embeddings. When a task whose two variants received different human labels involves the kinds of action seen in the current run, both of its variants are included, so that the judge sees where necessary treatment ends. Following the rule, the judge first identifies the work that the answer card requires, then checks whether any further action treats the risk that e e addresses beyond what e e allows, asking for each such action whether it would become reasonable if e e were absent. The prompts and retrieval details are given in Appendix F . paragraphs.en: Our results show that appropriate risk treatment is an independent capability that current coding agents have yet to acquire, and that their failures follow patterns in human risk management. Complete results, significance analyses, case studies, and computational resource consumption are detailed in Appendices L , M , N , and O . Our key Obs ervations are summarized below.

paragraphs.en: Obs ❶: Unnecessary risk treatment is pervasive and varies widely across configurations. ParanoiaEval consistently separates agent behavior across paired variants. As shown in Table 2 and Figure 4 a, every configuration exhibits excess treatment of r p r_{p} less often on E + E^{+} than on E − E^{-} overall, and this reduction is significant in every configuration, with Holm-adjusted p p -values of at most 0.012 (Table 3 ). However, the response is far from complete and varies widely across configurations, with ER ranging from only 25.4% to 65.5%. As a result, unnecessary risk treatment still occurs in 11.2%–58.7% of E + E^{+} runs, and every configuration exhibits it under all four treatments. Its form follows the treatment. For example, under mitigation, agents broaden verification beyond the stated bound, and under acceptance, they ask the user to reconfirm a decision that has already been made. Reading VR together with ER further separates the sources of a low violation rate. Sonnet-4.6 attains the lowest VR mainly because it rarely applies such treatment even on E − E^{-} , whereas Haiku-4.5 responds most strongly to the evidence and attains the highest ER. VR also differs across models within the same harness, ranging from 11.2% to 58.7% in Claude Code and from 18.2% to 25.5% in Codex.

paragraphs.en: Obs ❷: Stronger task capability does not ensure appropriate risk treatment. paragraphs.en: Obs ❸: Treatment violations substantially harm developers. To examine how these violations affect developers in practice, we further analyze the results of the human study. As shown in Figure 4 c and Table 4 , developers rate runs with excess treatment 1.27 points lower in satisfaction on the 5-point scale than runs without it, with p < 0.001 p<0.001 . They would accept the output of such runs as is in only 38% of cases, compared with 78% otherwise. The penalty appears under every treatment, ranging from 1.10 points for avoidance to 1.55 points for mitigation, which also has the lowest acceptance rate of 28%. Ratings are consistent across developers, with a Krippendorff’s α \alpha ( Krippendorff, 2004 ) of 0.76. The results indicate that unnecessary treatment imposes real costs that functional metrics fail to capture.
paragraphs.zh: 观察结果 ❸：治疗违规行为对开发者造成严重损害。 为了探究这些违规行为在实践中如何影响开发者，我们进一步分析了人类研究的结果。 如图 4c 和表 4 所示，在 5 分制满意度评分中，开发者对存在过度治疗的运行评分比没有此类运行的低 1.27 分（p < 0.001）。 在这种情况下，他们仅会在 38% 的情况下接受此类运行的原始输出，而正常情况下的接受率为 78%。 这种惩罚出现在所有治疗类型中：回避型治疗的惩罚为 1.10 分，缓解型治疗的惩罚为 1.55 分，后者同时也是接受率最低（28%）的类型。 各开发者的评分具有一致性，Krippendorff’s α \alpha（Krippendorff, 2004）值为 0.76。 研究结果表明，不必要的治疗会带来实际成本，而这些成本是功能指标无法捕捉到的。

paragraphs.en: Obs ❹: Violations follow patterns established in risk management. Analyzed under ATMA, the violations are neither isolated nor random. As shown in Tables 2 and 5 , mitigation and acceptance reach a higher ER than avoidance and transfer in every configuration. Mitigation provides the clearest example. Risk-management research observes that mitigation lacks a natural stopping point, so that its extent must be set explicitly by weighing its cost against the risk it reduces ( Feather et al., 2006 ; Špačková & Straub, 2015 ) . Agents behave accordingly. When the instruction states the magnitude of treatment, such as the number of repetitions or the scope of testing, the bound gives them a point at which to stop. When the magnitude is left unquantified, they keep repeating and broadening verification. As shown in Figure 4 d, removing the stated bound raises the rate of excess treatment in all 8 configurations, by up to 68.7 pp. By contrast, the literature regards forgoing further treatment as a rational choice once the responsible party has decided to bear a risk, with the explicit decision marking the stopping point ( Kutsch & Hall, 2009 ) . Most agents likewise stop when the principal’s decision is recorded in the instruction, so that acceptance reaches an ER of up to 93.9%. Case studies of both treatments are presented in Appendix N . These parallels suggest that the difficulties recognized in human risk management recur in coding agents, so that established knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability .
paragraphs.zh: 观察 ❹：违规行为遵循风险管理中已确立的模式。 在 ATMA 框架下分析后，这些违规行为既非孤立事件，也非随机发生。 如表 2 和表 5 所示，在所有配置中，缓解和接受策略的 ER 均高于规避和转移策略。 缓解策略是最清晰的例证。 风险管理研究指出，缓解策略缺乏自然的停止点，因此其实施程度必须通过权衡其成本与所降低的风险来明确设定（Feather 等，2006；Špačková & Straub，2015）。 智能体也会据此行事。 当指令中明确了处理的程度，例如重复次数或测试范围时，这一界限会为其提供停止的节点。 如果程度未被量化，它们就会持续重复并扩大验证范围。 如图 4d 所示，移除明确设定的界限会使所有 8 种配置中过度处理的比率上升，最高可达 68.7 个百分点。 相比之下，相关文献认为，一旦责任方决定承担风险，放弃进一步处理便是一种理性选择，而这一明确决策本身即标志着停止点（Kutsch & Hall，2009）。 大多数智能体在指令中记录委托方的决策时也会停止，因此接受的 ER 最高可达 93.9%。 两种处理方式的案例研究均列于附录 N 中。 这些相似性表明，人类风险管理中已识别出的问题在编码智能体时也会重复出现，因此来自人类实践的经验知识可用于指导这一能力的诊断与改进。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ParanoiaEval , the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Built on the well-established ATMA framework, ParanoiaEval reveals that unnecessary risk treatment is pervasive, establishes risk treatment as an independent capability dimension, and connects the diagnosis of this capability to knowledge from human software engineering practice. We believe this work takes coding-agent evaluation a step further, from completing tasks to working like experienced developers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ParanoiaEval，这是首个用于统一评估编码智能体风险处理能力的基准测试。 ParanoiaEval 建立在成熟的 ATMA 框架之上，揭示了不必要的风险处理普遍存在，确立了风险处理作为一个独立的能力维度，并将这一能力的诊断与人类软件工程实践中的知识联系起来。 我们相信，这项工作将编码智能体的评估推进了一步——从完成任务到像经验丰富的开发者一样工作。

sents.en: The release includes the 200 evidence-controlled task pairs over 50 repositories, with condition-specific instructions, answer cards, executable oracles, and reference solutions; container recipes for every repository; the agent runners for Codex and Claude Code; and the judge, comprising its rules, prompt assembly, and the frozen 64-record exemplar memory built from consensus human labels.
sents.zh: 该发布版本包含来自 50 个仓库的 200 对经过证据控制的任务，以及针对特定条件的指令、答案卡、可执行预言机和参考解决方案；每个仓库的容器配方；用于 Codex 和 Claude Code 的智能体运行器；以及评判器，其中包括其规则、提示组装和基于人类共识标签构建的包含 64 条记录的固定示例记忆。

sents.en: The appendix documents the benchmark design, task construction, evaluation criteria, experimental protocol, judge validation, and reported analyses.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Boundary. The task pairs isolate the effect of evidence by varying a single treatment-defining fact. In real development, relevant evidence may be dispersed, ambiguous, or conflicting, so performance on these controlled pairs does not fully represent performance in less structured environments. In addition, although the evaluation relies on expert-defined rules, human annotation, and judge calibration, residual judging errors may remain.
paragraphs.zh: 评估边界。 该任务配对通过改变单个定义处理的事实，来隔离证据的影响。 在实际开发中，相关证据可能分散、模糊或相互矛盾，因此在这些受控配对上的表现并不能完全代表在结构较不清晰环境中的表现。 此外，尽管评估依赖于专家定义的规则、人类标注和裁判校准，但仍可能存在残留的评判错误。

paragraphs.en: Scope of Empirical Generalization. Our empirical findings are based on 44 situations observed in practice, their instantiation across 50 open-source Python and Go repositories, and a post-hoc human study with experienced coding-agent users drawn from a single regional developer population. These findings support the behavioral and experiential effects observed within the evaluated settings, but should not be generalized unconditionally to other development ecosystems, repository types, or user populations.
paragraphs.zh: 经验泛化的范围。 我们的经验性发现基于在实践中观察到的 44 种情况、这些情况在 50 个开源 Python 和 Go 仓库中的具体实现，以及一项事后的人类研究；该研究参与者是从单一地区开发者群体中挑选的、有经验的编码智能体用户。 这些发现支持在评估设置中观察到的行为和体验效应，但不应无条件地将其推广到其他开发生态系统、仓库类型或用户群体。

paragraphs.en: Evidence Location. The treatment-defining evidence for mitigation and acceptance resides in the instruction, whereas the evidence for avoidance and transfer mostly resides in the repository. Differences in evidence responsiveness across treatments may therefore partly reflect how readily agents encounter evidence in each location, in addition to the structure of the treatment itself. Separating the two factors would require pairs that place the same treatment-defining fact in both locations.
paragraphs.zh: 证据位置。 决定处理方式的缓解与接受相关的证据存在于说明中，而回避与转移相关的证据则主要存在于存储库中。 因此，不同处理方式对证据的响应差异可能部分反映了智能体在各个位置获取证据的便捷程度，此外还与处理方式本身的结构有关。 要区分这两个因素，就需要将同一决定处理方式的证据同时置于两个位置的组合。

paragraphs.en: This section describes how the 44 recurring situations were derived from coding-agent logs. The source pool contains 18,922 deidentified sessions in which developers used general-purpose coding agents in routine software development. The sessions cover multiple repositories and development workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了如何根据编码智能体日志推导出这 44 种重复出现的情况。 源数据池包含 18,922 个经过匿名处理的会话，在这些会话中，开发者在常规软件开发过程中使用了通用型编码智能体。 这些会话涵盖了多个代码库和开发工作流程。

sents.en: This section describes how the 44 recurring situations were derived from coding-agent logs.
sents.zh: 本节介绍了如何根据编码智能体日志推导出这 44 种重复出现的情况。

sents.en: The source pool contains 18,922 deidentified sessions in which developers used general-purpose coding agents in routine software development.
sents.zh: 源数据池包含 18,922 个经过匿名处理的会话，在这些会话中，开发者在常规软件开发过程中使用了通用型编码智能体。

sents.en: The sessions cover multiple repositories and development workflows.
sents.zh: 这些会话涵盖了多个代码库和开发工作流程。

paragraphs.en: We use the task boundaries recorded in the session logs to extract the interaction segments associated with individual development tasks. Each segment contains the user request and the subsequent agent interaction needed to interpret the observed behavior. Multiple automated screening models independently examine these segments for potential over-defensive behavior. The screeners look for a concrete defensive action, the failure or risk that motivates it, and sufficient surrounding context to determine whether the action may exceed what the available evidence warrants. To favor recall at this stage, a segment is retained whenever at least one screening model marks it as a potential candidate. This procedure produces 6,078 candidate segments from the 18,922 source sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用会话日志中记录的任务边界，提取与各个开发任务相关的交互片段。 每个片段都包含用户请求以及为解释所观察到的行为而需要的后续智能体交互。 多个自动化筛选模型独立地检查这些片段，以识别潜在的过度防御性行为。 筛选模型会寻找具体的防御性行动、促使该行动发生的失败或风险，以及足够的上下文背景，以判断该行动是否可能超出了可用证据所支持的范围。 为了在此阶段优先保留可能符合条件的片段，只要至少有一个筛选模型将其标记为潜在候选片段，就会予以保留。 通过此流程，我们从 18,922 个源会话中获得了 6,078 个候选片段。

paragraphs.en: Two experts independently review every candidate segment. The initial annotation uses open coding without a predefined taxonomy. For each segment, the experts determine whether it contains over-defensive behavior, assign a free-form description of the observed situation, and provide a concise rationale grounded in the interaction record. A segment is retained when the record identifies a defensive action and its motivating failure mode, while the available evidence shows that the action exceeds the minimal sufficient response. The coding excludes incorrect conclusions, ineffective checks, safety refusals, user-requested verification procedures, and tasks whose requested output is itself a validator.
paragraphs.zh: 两位专家独立审查每个候选片段。 初始标注采用开放式编码，不使用预定义的分类体系。 对于每个片段，专家需判断其是否包含过度防御性行为，对观察到的情况以自由形式进行描述，并提供基于交互记录的简明依据。 当记录识别出某种防御性行动及其引发的失效模式，且现有证据表明该行动超出了最低必要响应时，则保留该片段。 编码过程排除错误结论、无效检查、安全拒绝、用户请求的验证程序，以及其所需输出本身即为验证器的任务。

paragraphs.en: We embed the free-form labels and rationales and cluster semantically related records to organize the consensus-valid segments. paragraphs.en: This section lists the 44 recurring situations represented in ParanoiaEval . Each situation is defined by the evidence that establishes its treatment rather than by the surface form of the agent’s action. The same action may therefore appear under different treatments. Situations with similar surface actions are separated by what establishes the treatment. Avoidance applies when the repository state excludes the failure. Transfer applies when the evidence assigns treatment to a party or mechanism other than the agent and its principal, such as continuous integration, version control, an upstream validator, or a maintainer. Acceptance applies when the principal records a decision, including a decision to retain the next step, because a risk retained by the principal satisfies owner ⁡ ( r ) = 𝒜 \mathrm{owner}(r)=\mathcal{A} (Appendix B ). For example, One-off or short-lived work (Avoidance) and Disposable script (Acceptance) differ in whether the repository or the user establishes that the work is disposable, and Human review (Transfer) and User-owned next step (Acceptance) differ in whether the follow-up is assigned to a maintainer or retained by the user. The tables also report the number of benchmark tasks constructed for each situation.
paragraphs.zh: 本节列出了 ParanoiaEval 中体现的 44 种重复出现的情况。 每种情况都由确立其处理方式的证据定义，而非智能体行为的表面形式。 因此，同一行为可能出现在不同的处理方式下。 表面行为相似的情况，通过确立处理方式的因素加以区分。 当仓库状态排除了失败时，适用“规避”。 当证据将处理方式分配给除智能体及其委托人以外的其他方或机制（例如持续集成、版本控制、上游验证器或维护者）时，适用“转移”。 当委托人记录一项决策（包括保留下一步的决策）时，适用“接受”，因为委托人保留的风险满足 owner⁡(r)=𝒜\mathrm{owner}(r)=\mathcal{A}（附录 B）。 例如，“一次性或短期工作”（规避）与“一次性脚本”（接受）的区别在于，是由仓库还是用户确定该工作为一次性；而“人工审查”（转移）与“用户拥有的下一步”（接受）的区别在于，后续步骤是分配给维护者还是由用户保留。 这些表格还报告了为每种情况构建的基准任务数量。

paragraphs.en: Attribution and trajectory label. An evidence-linked action treats the risk controlled by the decisive fact beyond the treatment that fact establishes, and would become reasonable if that fact were removed. A generic action is verification, hedging, or confirmation unrelated to that risk. A trajectory is labeled evidence if any evidence-linked action occurs, generic if it contains only generic unnecessary actions, and none otherwise. The evidence label takes precedence when both kinds occur.
paragraphs.zh: 归因与轨迹标签。 一项证据关联行动所控制的风险，超出了该事实所确立的处理范围；如果移除该事实，这项行动将变得合理。 通用行动是指与上述风险无关的验证、规避或确认行为。 如果轨迹中存在任何证据关联行动，则被标记为证据轨迹；如果仅包含不必要的通用行动，则标记为通用轨迹；否则不标记。 当两种类型的行动同时出现时，证据标签优先适用。

paragraphs.en: Form and degree. The annotation records each action’s observable form, including guards, backups, verification loops, new infrastructure, scope expansion, fallbacks or shims, confirmation requests, hedging, and a residual other category. For evidence-linked actions, minor denotes a small local addition or one inexpensive extra check that does not change the deliverable’s shape. The clear degree denotes work that materially enlarges the task or its persistent artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 形式与程度。 该标注记录了每个动作的可观察形式，包括守卫、备份、验证循环、新基础设施、范围扩展、备用方案或适配层、确认请求、风险对冲以及一个“其他”剩余类别。 对于与证据相关的动作，“轻微”指局部的小幅添加，或一次成本不高的额外检查，且不会改变交付成果的基本形态。 “明确”的程度则指那些实质性扩大任务规模或其持久化产出的工作。

paragraphs.en: Baseline and exclusions. Ordinary repository reading, an answer-card-approved targeted test, a focused lint or formatting check, a justified rerun after an intervening change, a final diff inspection, and steps required by the execution environment remain within the baseline unless the answer card states otherwise. A full-suite run is also within the baseline unless the current evidence excludes it or the answer card counts it as excessive. Task failure, an incorrect conclusion, or a fabricated claim is recorded separately and does not by itself establish unnecessary defensive work.
paragraphs.zh: 基线范围与排除项。 常规仓库读取、经答案卡批准的定向测试、集中式 lint 或格式检查、在中间变更后的合理重新运行、最终差异检查，以及执行环境要求的步骤，均属于基线范围，除非答案卡另有说明。 完整套件运行也属于基线范围，除非当前证据将其排除，或答案卡认为其属于过度操作。 任务失败、错误结论或捏造的主张将单独记录，且本身并不构成不必要的防御性工作。

paragraphs.zh: 两位标注专家与负责任务构建和验证的两位专家不同。

paragraphs.en: The annotation procedure comprises three stages.
paragraphs.zh: 标注流程包括三个阶段。

paragraphs.en: Independent review. The two annotation experts review each structured trajectory independently without seeing one another’s decisions or the Judge prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 独立评审。 两位标注专家各自独立评审每条结构化轨迹，互不查看对方的决策或“法官”的预测结果。

paragraphs.en: Structured annotation. For each record, they assign the three-way trajectory label, identify the actions beyond the baseline, record their forms and evidence locations, assign the largest evidence-linked degree, and provide a concise rationale. Task completion and whether the agent encountered the decisive fact are recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化标注。 对于每条记录，他们需分配三路轨迹标签，识别超出基线范围的操作，记录其形式与证据位置，分配最大的证据关联程度，并提供简洁的说明理由。 任务完成状态以及智能体是否遇到了决定性事实将分别记录。

paragraphs.en: Adjudication. The experts compare the complete records and revisit the answer card and trajectory whenever they disagree about the label, action list, attribution, degree, or supporting evidence. They discuss each disagreement until they reach a consensus record. Only consensus records are used as Judge exemplars or validation references.
paragraphs.zh: 裁决。 当专家们在标签、行动列表、归因、程度或支持证据方面存在分歧时，他们会比较完整记录，并重新审视答案卡和推理过程。 他们会就每一次分歧进行讨论，直到达成一致的记录。 只有达成一致的记录才会被用作裁判的范例或验证参考。

paragraphs.en: We follow the memory-augmented evaluation paradigm of AgentAuditor ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . An initial Judge without memory predicts both variants of each candidate task. For every treatment, we sample two tasks from each of four pair-level prediction patterns. The patterns cover cases in which both variants are flagged, only E + E^{+} is flagged, only E − E^{-} is flagged, and neither variant is flagged. This process yields 32 tasks and 64 condition-specific trajectories. The stratification controls coverage during task sampling and does not balance the final human labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 AgentAuditor（Luo 等人，2025）提出的增强记忆评估范式。 一个没有记忆能力的初始 Judge 会预测每个候选任务的两种变体。 对于每种处理方案，我们从四种成对预测模式中的每一种抽取两个任务。 这些模式涵盖了两种变体均被标记、仅 E + E^{+} 被标记、仅 E − E^{-} 被标记，以及两种变体均未被标记的情况。 该过程生成 32 个任务和 64 条与特定条件相关的轨迹。 这种分层策略在任务抽样过程中控制了覆盖范围，但不会平衡最终的人类标注结果。

paragraphs.en: The two experts annotate all 64 trajectories under the shared rules above and adjudicate every disagreement. Every consensus record in the memory split is retained. We apply no resampling, removal, weighting, or balancing based on the final human labels. Each memory record stores the task description, condition role, answer card and M ⁡ ( t ) M(t) , consensus label, annotated actions with their evidence locations, and a brief rationale. The task description is embedded in advance for cosine-similarity retrieval. A coarse action-form signature is used only to prioritize relevant contrast pairs and does not enter the similarity score. The Judge prompt, judging rules, and memory bank are frozen before held-out validation. The memory and validation splits contain no overlapping tasks, and validation records do not enter the memory bank.
paragraphs.zh: 两位专家根据上述共享规则对全部 64 条轨迹进行标注，并裁定所有分歧。 内存划分中的每一条共识记录均被保留。 我们不基于最终的人类标签进行任何重采样、移除、加权或平衡操作。 每条记忆记录存储任务描述、条件角色、答案卡与 M⁡(t) M(t)、共识标签、带有证据位置的标注动作，以及简要的推理依据。 任务描述已预先嵌入，用于余弦相似度检索。 粗略的动作形式签名仅用于优先选择相关的对比对，不会进入相似度得分。 在预留验证之前，“裁判”提示词、判断规则与记忆库均被冻结。 内存划分与验证划分不包含任何重叠的任务，且验证记录不会进入记忆库。

paragraphs.en: The sampling frame contains only oracle-passing E + E^{+} runs. Runs with V p = 1 V_{p}=1 are sampled by treatment, with up to 100 runs retained per treatment and all eligible runs used when fewer are available. Each selected record retains the judge-assigned degree of excess treatment. Records without excess treatment ( V p = 0 V_{p}=0 ) are drawn first from the tasks represented among the selected excess-treatment runs, then by treatment and agent configuration until the study sample is complete.
paragraphs.zh: 抽样框架仅包含通过神谕测试的 E + E^{+} 次运行。 V p = 1 V_{p}=1 的运行按治疗组进行抽样，每组最多保留 100 次运行；若可用运行数量不足，则使用所有符合条件的运行。 每个选中的记录均保留由评判者指定的过量治疗程度。 无过量治疗的记录（V p = 0 V_{p}=0）首先从所选过量治疗运行中代表的任务中抽取，然后按治疗组和智能体配置继续抽取，直至研究样本完整。

paragraphs.en: Same-task records are assigned to different participants, and participant pairings rotate across records. paragraphs.en: Every episode begins in a fresh container created from the verified repository image. The condition fixture is applied before execution, and an independent configuration directory prevents conversation state, cached context, or workspace changes from carrying across episodes. The agent can inspect and modify the complete condition-specific repository through its native file and shell tools. It cannot access the answer card, reference solution, executable oracle, Judge materials, paired condition, or artifacts from other runs. Repository dependencies are installed in advance, and network access is limited to the provider service required by the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 每个回合都始于一个由经过验证的仓库镜像创建的全新容器。 在执行前会应用条件固定装置，且独立的配置目录可防止对话状态、缓存上下文或工作区变更在不同回合间延续。 智能体可以通过其原生文件和 shell 工具检查并修改完整的特定条件的仓库内容。 它无法访问答案卡、参考解决方案、可执行预言机、裁判材料、配对条件或其他运行产生的产物。 仓库依赖项会提前安装，且网络访问仅限于运行环境所需的服务提供商服务。

paragraphs.en: This section presents two paired case studies selected from the recorded benchmark runs. The first shows a user-owned next step providing an acceptance boundary for further test work. The second shows verification expanding when no mitigation magnitude is stated. The cases illustrate the contrasting stopping structures highlighted in the main findings. Each pair holds the model, task, harness, answer card, oracle, judge configuration, and all task content outside the treatment-defining evidence fixed. We report only observable instructions, tool actions, outputs, repository changes, and evaluation records. Repository identities and internal run identifiers are omitted. As throughout the benchmark, the verdict on each E − E^{-} run is taken against the E + E^{+} answer card. An evidence-linked label there records a treatment that the E + E^{+} evidence would have excluded, not a violation in E − E^{-} .
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了从已记录的基准测试运行中挑选出的两对案例研究。 第一个案例展示了一个用户自主提出的后续步骤，为进一步的测试工作设定了接受边界。 第二个案例展示了在未说明缓解措施幅度的情况下，验证过程如何扩展。 这些案例说明了主要发现中强调的两种截然不同的停止结构。 每一对案例都包含模型、任务、测试框架、答案卡、预言机、评判器配置，以及除定义处理方案的关键证据之外的所有任务内容均保持不变。 我们仅报告可观察到的指令、工具操作、输出结果、仓库变更和评估记录。 仓库身份标识和内部运行标识符均已省略。 与整个基准测试一致，每次 E − E^{-} 运行的判定均以 E + E^{+} 答案卡为参照。 其中，一个与证据相关的标签记录了一种处理方案——这种方案本应被 E + E^{+} 的证据排除，而非表示 E − E^{-} 中的违规行为。
